شععتن (form I)
# شَعَعْتُنَّ (šaʕaʕtunna) /ʃa.ʕaʕ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of شَعَّ (šaʕʕa)
# شُعِعْتُنَّ (šuʕiʕtunna) /ʃu.ʕiʕ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of شَعَّ (šaʕʕa)
